project_shape.reason: a package manifest with no web, API or mobile entry point

findings.title: No vulnerability disclosure contact
findings.detail: There is no SECURITY.md or security.txt. When a researcher finds something, the absence of a named contact is what turns a quiet report into a public disclosure, or into an email to a support address that nobody reads for three weeks.
findings.fix: Add `SECURITY.md` with a contact address, what is in scope, the response time you commit to, and whether you permit good-faith testing.
findings.fix_snippet:
# SECURITY.md at the repository root

## Reporting a vulnerability
Email security@example.com. You'll get an acknowledgement within 2 business
days and an assessment within 7.

We won't pursue legal action against good-faith research under this policy.
Please don't access data that isn't yours, and give us time to fix it before
disclosing publicly.

caveat: Absence is reliable; presence is not. This tool reports signals found in source code. It is not legal advice and it is not an audit.
